description: Given a register snapshot, decide which stale PENDING approvals may be marked SUPERSEDED - refusing per target on anything unexpected, and refusing wholesale unless the approval that must survive is present exactly once and PENDING.
why_it_exists: Repeated end-to-end QA reruns of one drafting action each raised a fresh approval request against a newer draft, leaving three PENDING approvals live on a single action. Any of them could have been decided by the owner, and deciding a stale one would have sent an out-of-date draft. This one-shot was written on 2026-08-21 on the owner's instruction to close the two overtaken requests as an AUDIT action, explicitly not as a decision: they were neither approved nor rejected.

input.sanitisation_note: approval_ids keep the real format APR- + 16 uppercase hex characters and the real length; matter and action ids keep MAT-YYYYMMDD-NNN and ACT-YYYYMMDD-NNN-QA-NNN. token_hash_or_reference values are 16 hex characters, matching the post-F-02 content-hash width. None of the assertions depend on the hash values themselves.

expect.keep_untouched: APR-A1B2C3D400000003 remains PENDING; it is never written
expect.audit_message_shape: Superseded by <KEEP>, which covers draft <keepDraft>. This approval covered draft <draft_id> with content hash <token_hash_or_reference>. Each end-to-end QA rerun of <ACTION> raised a fresh approval request, so this one was overtaken by a later draft rather than decided. Superseded on the owner instruction of 2026-08-21 as an audit action, not a decision: it was NOT approved and NOT rejected.

refusal_cases.keep_missing_or_not_pending: return a single refusal for the whole run; supersede nothing, because leaving this action with no live approval would be worse than leaving stale ones
refusal_cases.target_absent: refuse that target: 'Approval <id> is not on the register.'
refusal_cases.target_duplicated: refuse that target: a duplicate key must be resolved by a human
refusal_cases.target_already_superseded: refuse that target: no write needed
refusal_cases.target_any_other_status: refuse that target: I will not overwrite a recorded decision
refusal_cases.target_wrong_matter: refuse that target: it does not belong to the authorised test matter

assertions: The KEEP approval is asserted, not assumed: if it is not present exactly once with status PENDING, nothing at all is superseded and a single refusal is returned.
Only the approvals explicitly named in TARGETS may be written; no other approval row is touched.
A target is refused, not forced, when it is absent, duplicated, already SUPERSEDED, in any status other than PENDING, or attached to a matter other than the authorised one.
The terminal state is SUPERSEDED with decision SUPERSEDED and decided_by QA-AUDIT - never APPROVED, REJECTED or VOID.
The audit message records both drafts, the surviving approval, the content hash of the superseded draft, and states in words that this was not a decision.
The audit message is truncated to 900 characters before being written.
The Events write uses appendOrUpdate matched on a deterministic event_id, so re-running the audit updates one row per approval rather than appending more.
The mutation branch runs only on items where safe_to_supersede is true; refusals go to a separate branch that explains and writes nothing.
target_unresolved_reason: One-shot audit workflow Z0phpkSNeLngQpl1. Its decision logic was never extracted into a WF4 Code node.
